verdict.rationale: The models overview states that all current models accept text and image input and produce text output. That covers image input and honestly scopes the supported modalities, implying audio is not accepted. The `/v1/models` capabilities object also lets developers discover per-model support programmatically. Missing for 10: dedicated vision/image-input documentation (formats, limits), evidence of native PDF/document input (the Skills item covers document-creation tasks, not input), an explicit statement on audio, and independent hands-on corroboration.
